rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
# Otherwise configure takes the first ones in the path, which are those of # the tools folder. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" LIBGCRYPT_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/libgcrypt-config" \ XML_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/xml2-config" \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules \ --disable-static \ --with-crypto \ --without-python
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
find "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" -name '*.la' -delete rm -rf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/cmake"
